page.overview:
Who is Aidus?

Aidus was a Rattataki warrior who lived on the planet Rattatak during the Clone Wars. He was a loyal subject of the Dark Jedi Asajj Ventress when, in 22 BBY, they imprisoned Jedi Knight Obi-Wan Kenobi and his clone officer Alpha-17 in their fortress on Rattatak.
